statement.zh: **算法**：bcrypt 自适应口令散列（bcrypt）。机制本身由第 5 节直接印出：「Bcrypt uses a 128-bit salt and encrypts a 192-bit magic value.」紧接的一句给出它依赖的部件，「It takes advantage of the expensive key setup in eksblow sh.」——注意件里就印作 eksblow sh，连字在抽取时丢了，这里按原字形引用而不改写。
statement.en: **Algorithm**: bcrypt (bcrypt 自适应口令散列).The mechanism is printed as-is in Section 5: “Bcrypt uses a 128-bit salt and encrypts a 192-bit magic value.” The next sentence names what it leans on, “It takes advantage of the expensive key setup in eksblow sh.” — the retained text really prints eksblow sh, the ligature was lost in extraction, so it is quoted in that form rather than repaired.

statement.zh: 设计理由写在摘要里：论文「show that the computational cost of any secure password scheme must increase as hardware improves」，并在同一段给出两种可调配价的算法；该段把两个算法印在一处，「cost|eksblow sh, a block cipher with a purposefully expensive key schedule, and bcrypt, a related hash function」——注意这里的破折号在件里就印作竖线 |，跨度照原样带上它。
statement.en: The rationale sits in the abstract: the paper will “show that the computational cost of any secure password scheme must increase as hardware improves”, and the same paragraph names the two adaptable-cost algorithms together, “cost|eksblow sh, a block cipher with a purposefully expensive key schedule, and bcrypt, a related hash function” — in this file the em dash there is printed as a vertical bar |, and the span carries it.

statement.zh: 用途与实现位置由论文自己的结构句给出：「Section 5 introduces the variable-cost bcrypt password hashing function and describes our implementation in the OpenBSD operating system」，即这套可变代价的口令散列是随 OpenBSD 实现一起提出的；名称由来在同一节首句里印作「bcrypt, referring to the Blow」后面的加密算法名。
statement.en: Use and implementation venue come from the paper’s own roadmap sentence, “Section 5 introduces the variable-cost bcrypt password hashing function and describes our implementation in the OpenBSD operating system”, and the name is explained at the head of that section, where the text prints “bcrypt, referring to the Blow” followed by the cipher’s name.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 边界不是被攻破，而是旧方案为何失效，论文把这一点印成一句：「the big aw in UNIX password security is not its openly readable password le.Rather, it is the choice of a hash function that cannot adapt to a 50,000 fold increase in the speed of hardware and software.」件里 aw 与 le 是丢连字后的原字形，跨度照抄；换算法的理由据此成立。
statement.en: The limit is not a break but a failure mode, printed as one claim: “the big aw in UNIX password security is not its openly readable password le.Rather, it is the choice of a hash function that cannot adapt to a 50,000 fold increase in the speed of hardware and software.” The aw and le are the extraction’s own glyphs, copied verbatim, and the case for changing the hash follows from that sentence.

statement.zh:
断代证据写在同一行：「At the time of deployment in 1976, crypt could hash fewer than 4 passwords per second.」与「over 200,000 crypt operations per second」——1976 与两端的速率都由件本身印出，因此该条目目只谈这份 1999 年论文给出的速率对比，不谈发明者与更早的来历（留存件没有提供）。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(C=E_K(P;r),\qquad P=D_K(C)\)。输入：输入：bcrypt 自适应口令散列的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：P 明文，C 密文，K 密钥，r 随机化参数。
statement.en: The dating evidence is on one line: “At the time of deployment in 1976, crypt could hash fewer than 4 passwords per second.” and later “over 200,000 crypt operations per second” — both the year 1976 and the two rates are printed by the retained file, so this entry speaks only to the speed comparison in the 1999 paper and says nothing about inventors or earlier origins, which this text does not provide.
